definition: Asset identity is a stable schema identifier separate from node identity, coordinates and lineage.
integration: Allows one immutable asset to be instanced by many scene nodes.

definition: Canonical mesh/material/source metadata are hashed so derived geometry can be cached and compared.
integration: Cache key and integrity check; not a legal or cryptographic identity claim.

definition: Nodes form an explicit parent-child transform graph with local and world transforms.
integration: Supports conventional scene composition while UGTS events remain authoritative for changes.

definition: Parent edits are accepted only when the scene graph remains acyclic.
formula: parent walk must not revisit a node
integration: Prevents undefined world transforms and recursive editor corruption.

definition: Mesh/material assets are immutable payloads; nodes carry transform, visibility, tags and lineage.
integration: Allows reuse and streaming without treating render meshes as identity.

definition: Ordered layers may override declared node fields without destructively rewriting the base scene.
integration: Reference form of non-destructive authoring and variant overrides.

definition: Every scene declares up axis, handedness and working coordinate convention.
integration: Prevents silent axis flips across engine, glTF, USD and XR adapters.

definition: Linear scale, time unit and working color space are schema fields.
integration: Separates authored values from implicit engine defaults.

definition: World bounds map deterministically to one or more spatial cells.
integration: Supplies world partition and asynchronous loading keys.

definition: Version changes append an explicit from/to migration entry and description.
integration: Makes save-game and asset upgrades inspectable and replay-safe.

definition: Cubic Bezier segments subdivide until a declared flatness tolerance or depth limit is reached.
integration: Produces render/collision polylines from authoritative curves.

mechanism: Dual simulation and presentation error contract
definition: Derived geometry records independent world, collision, screen-space and normal error budgets.
integration: Prevents visually acceptable meshes from silently redefining event geometry.

definition: Closed 2D paths use an explicitly selected winding rule for interior classification.
integration: Supports vector fills, guards and hit regions without ambiguous self-intersections.

definition: An open polyline is compiled to a ribbon mesh with explicit width and join policy.
integration: Reference path-to-triangle conversion for editor and runtime previews.

definition: A profile ring is swept along a sampled 3D path to form a triangle mesh.
integration: Makes 2.0 curve families renderable and exportable.

definition: Rotation-minimizing tangent/normal/binormal frames orient profiles across low-curvature sections.
integration: Avoids Frenet flips at near-zero curvature.

definition: A bounded 3D lattice samples a declared scalar field and iso value.
integration: Input stage for deterministic field-to-mesh compilation.

definition: Each voxel cube is decomposed into tetrahedra and crossing edges are triangulated.
integration: Reference isosurface compiler with bounded resolution and no hidden raymarch loop.

definition: Analytic gradients are preferred; finite differences supply a bounded fallback.
integration: Supplies lighting orientation and diagnostic residuals.

definition: Tube vertices receive angular and cumulative-length coordinates.
integration: Provides stable procedural material coordinates.

definition: A derived axis-aligned proxy mesh is emitted from authoritative bounds.
integration: Allows inexpensive broad-phase and fallback collision.

definition: Triangle subsets form deterministic lower-detail previews with explicit topology-preservation status.
integration: Reference only; production simplification must preserve application error contracts.

definition: Each renderable or support volume may expose finite minimum/maximum bounds.
integration: Common currency for culling, broad phase and streaming.

definition: An optional local frame and half-extents describe tighter oriented bounds.
integration: Specified for production adapters; reference runtime falls back to AABB.

definition: A median split along the longest axis builds an inspectable hierarchy.
integration: Conventional acceleration complements UGTS support predicates.

definition: BVH overlap results pass through local-support predicates before exact relation work.
integration: Preserves the canonical support -> compatibility -> guard order.

definition: AABB positive vertices are tested against declared view planes.
formula: visible iff dot(n,p_positive)+d >= 0 for all planes
integration: Downstream view selection only; visibility does not change identity.

definition: Slab intervals return ordered AABB ray candidates.
integration: Editor picking and coarse interaction support.

definition: Object bounds enumerate every intersected regular-grid cell.
integration: Reference partition key for load/unload policies.

definition: Spatial overlap and required tags define a player/client interest set.
formula: interest={e: bounds(e) intersects query and tags_required subset tags(e)}
integration: Supports replication and streaming scope.

definition: Every rejected item reports frustum, support or compatibility cause.
integration: Makes editor and performance diagnostics actionable.

definition: Versioned numeric opcodes select pattern/field evaluators in coherent shader batches.
integration: GPU target keeps the 2.0 parameterized operator model.

definition: Instances store aligned offsets into a validated parameter buffer rather than inflating every hot record.
integration: Supports compact instancing and schema hashing.

definition: Bit flags declare analytic position, tangent, curvature, gradient or Hessian support.
integration: Missing derivatives select a declared numerical path.

definition: Passes declare read/write resources, queue class and dependency edges.
integration: Specified bridge from query results to raster/compute presentation.

definition: Visible instances may be compacted into indirect draw or mesh-dispatch commands.
integration: Production target; CPU reference emits ordinary SVG triangles.

definition: GPU kernels may append bounded event proposals with residual, status and confidence.
integration: Gameplay state is not committed by an unchecked shader write.

definition: Verified proposals are ordered by time, priority, source and proposal ID before state patches.
integration: Separates parallel detection from authoritative lineage change.

definition: Native target declares Vulkan 1.4-compatible resource, shader and timestamp contracts.
formula: backend=vulkan; physical_gpu_claim requires named device metrics
integration: No physical-GPU benchmark is claimed by this package.

definition: Portable target expresses compute and presentation kernels in WGSL-compatible layouts.
integration: Prototype shader supplied; browser/device execution remains target-specific.

definition: A deterministic camera, painter-order triangle pass and preview shader emit inspectable SVG.
integration: Regression oracle and demonstrator, not a production renderer.

definition: Base color, metallic, roughness, emissive and alpha mode have bounded ranges.
integration: Maps directly to common runtime asset conventions.

definition: Material graphs may read phase, curvature, arc length, sheet or pattern coordinates.
integration: Allows 2.0 patterns to drive masks and appearance.

definition: Small typed nodes evaluate constants, patterns, add, multiply, mix and clamp operations.
integration: Reference graph with explicit cycle rejection.

definition: Material evaluation is presentation-only and cannot mutate authoritative substrate state.
formula: material_output -> pixels; state change -> guard/event only
integration: Preserves the core reading rule.

definition: Lights declare kind, direction/color/intensity and shadow intent.
integration: Reference renderer implements one directional preview light; production shadows remain downstream.

definition: Scene-linear color is exposed and mapped through declared preview operators.
integration: Makes output transforms reproducible.

definition: Color-pipeline records may name an OCIO configuration and ACES profile/view.
integration: Interchange target only; this package does not bundle an OCIO runtime.

definition: Opaque, mask and blend modes are explicit material states.
integration: Prevents implicit ordering and collision semantics.

definition: Authoritative simulation advances in fixed dt while input and presentation may use separate clocks.
integration: Makes rollback and event ordering explicit.

definition: Scene, support, relation, motion, interaction and lineage data map to explicit engine components.
integration: Adapter contract; no engine-specific fork is authoritative.

definition: Joints form an acyclic transform hierarchy with inverse-bind and pose data.
integration: Production animation extension; no skinned character is bundled.

definition: Clips, blend states and guarded transitions carry versioned event labels.
integration: Animation events use the same event authority boundary.

definition: The 2.0 damped least-squares IK operator is connected to explicit joint-limit/constraint status.
integration: 2.0 reference implementation retained; 3D production constraints remain application-specific.

definition: Unsupported contacts and dense constraints may be delegated to a conventional physics solver.
integration: Prevents the event substrate from pretending to replace general contact mechanics.

definition: Crossing/impact produces an event; resting contact, joint and grasp use maintained constraints.
integration: Avoids infinite coincident-event emission.

definition: Capsule/shape sweeps return travel fraction, normal, support and compatibility status.
integration: Target interface for playable movement.

definition: Each hand records side, wrist pose, joints, radii, confidence, tracking state, source and timestamp.
integration: Input adapter boundary for XR, mocap or desktop emulation.

definition: Separate enter and exit distances prevent noisy pinch chatter.
formula: enter if d<=d_enter; exit if d>=d_exit, d_exit>d_enter
integration: Produces guarded interaction state with reason codes.

definition: The pair midpoint is the translation anchor for cooperative transforms.
integration: Stable pair frame independent of world origin.

definition: Object scale follows current hand separation relative to anchor separation within clamps.
integration: Supports direct two-hand sizing with a declared degeneracy policy.

definition: Shortest-axis alignment combines with averaged wrist twist around the current pair axis.
formula: q=q_twist*q_align; q_align maps a0 to a1
integration: Provides rotation without Euler-angle discontinuities.

definition: One- and two-hand ownership transitions are an explicit state machine.
integration: Supports join, release and simultaneous-grab events.

definition: When one hand releases a two-hand object, ownership persists under the remaining hand with a lineage label.
integration: Preserves interaction ancestry instead of silently changing controller.

definition: Low-confidence/untracked poses reject transforms; cursor input can emulate the same schema.
integration: Makes XR optional and keeps tests reproducible.

definition: Every committed event receives a monotonic sequence number and pre/post state hashes.
integration: Replication and editor timelines use the same ordering.

definition: Runtime snapshots are hashed and later events can be replayed from the nearest checkpoint.
integration: Reference rollback path for deterministic profiles.

definition: Canonical JSON over schema, scene and runtime counters produces a comparison digest.
integration: Divergence detector; digest is not a replacement for full state.

definition: Peers exchange schema version, mechanism support and asset hashes before authoritative replay.
integration: Production networking contract.

definition: Scene audits, event timelines, culling reasons, lineage edges and runtime metrics are machine-readable.
integration: Makes hidden support/guard/lineage state inspectable.

definition: Replay stops at the first sequence whose expected and actual state hashes differ.
integration: Prevents silent cross-platform desynchronization.

definition: GPU performance claims require a named physical device, driver, workload, precision and equal-error baseline.
formula: promote_claim iff physical_gpu and metrics_complete and oracle_match
integration: Retains the 1.1/2.0 evidence boundary.
